title: Making it easier for websites to express AI training preferences
summary: OpenAI will honor a shared robots.txt signal to help website operators communicate their AI training preferences to participating providers.
title_es: OpenAI, Google y Microsoft adoptan estándar para opt-out de scraping
bajada: Las mayores compañías de IA se comprometen a honrar un nuevo estándar basado en robots.txt que permite a los editores controlar si sus contenidos se usan para entrenar modelos. Esta iniciativa centraliza las preferencias de entrenamiento en un único lugar en lugar de requerir configuraciones individuales por empresa.
bajada_en: Major AI companies commit to honor a new robots.txt-based standard that lets publishers control whether their content is used for model training. This initiative centralizes training preferences in one place instead of requiring individual configurations per company.

title_es: Extensión de Anthropic en Cursor fue comprometida durante 12 horas
bajada: La extensión verificada de Anthropic para VS Code en Cursor fue hackeada, permitiendo a atacantes acceso no autorizado. El incident aún no ha revelado cómo los atacantes obtuvieron credenciales de la cuenta verificada, planteando preocupaciones sobre la seguridad de extensiones en herramientas de desarrollo.
bajada_en: Anthropic's verified VS Code extension on Cursor was hacked, giving attackers unauthorized access. The incident hasn't yet revealed how attackers obtained verified account credentials, raising concerns about extension security in developer tools.

title: Anthropic VS code extension on Cursor backdoored for nearly 12 hours
summary: It's still unknown how attackers got access to Anthropic's verified Cursor account.
title_es: Empleado de Accenture dejó agente Claude en red del Pentágono 2 meses
bajada: Un empleado de un contratista de defensa ejecutó un agente Claude personal en una red del Departamento de Defensa durante dos meses antes de ser detectado. El incidente expone riesgos significativos cuando herramientas de IA no controladas se despliegan en sistemas críticos de seguridad nacional.
bajada_en: A defense contractor employee ran a personal Claude agent on a Department of Defense network for two months before detection. The incident exposes significant risks when uncontrolled AI tools are deployed on critical national security systems.

title_es: Google transmite primera respuesta de IA desde satélite al espacio
bajada: Google logró ejecutar exitosamente su modelo Gemma 4 en un satélite equipado con TPUs, demostrando la viabilidad de ejecutar IA en órbita. El hito marca progreso en Project Suncatcher, el proyecto de la compañía para llevar computación de IA a infraestructura espacial.
bajada_en: Google successfully ran its Gemma 4 model on an orbiting satellite equipped with TPUs, demonstrating the feasibility of running AI in space. The milestone marks progress on Project Suncatcher, the company's effort to bring AI computing to space infrastructure.

title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
summary: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
title_es: Mistral lanza 'Le Chonk' compitiendo en performance con DeepSeek
bajada: El laboratorio francés Mistral afirma que su nuevo modelo 'Le Chonk' iguala o supera a los mejores modelos de DeepSeek y Z.ai en tareas de coding y ciberseguridad. El lanzamiento intensifica la competencia en la carrera de modelos open-weight entre Occidente y China.
bajada_en: French AI lab Mistral claims its new 'Le Chonk' model matches or outperforms DeepSeek and Z.ai's best models on coding and cybersecurity tasks. The release intensifies competition in the open-weight model race between the West and China.

title: Mistral Says Its AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Has Leapfrogged China in the Open-Weight Race
summary: The French AI lab claims its latest release matches or outperforms even the best models from DeepSeek and Z.ai in coding and cybersecurity.
title_es: S&P rebaja perspectiva de Meta por gastos masivos en IA
bajada: S&P Global Ratings bajó la perspectiva crediticia de Meta de estable a negativa, expresando dudas sobre la capacidad de la empresa para monetizar sus crecientes inversiones en IA. La agencia sugiere que Meta tiene limitaciones comparadas con peers en convertir gasto de IA en rentabilidad.
bajada_en: S&P Global Ratings downgraded Meta's credit outlook from stable to negative, questioning the company's ability to monetize its growing AI investments. The agency suggests Meta faces limitations compared to peers in converting AI spending into profitability.

title_es: OpenAI reduce objetivo de recaudación en $10 mil millones
bajada: OpenAI bajó su meta de fundraising de $30 mil millones a $20 mil millones, tras reducir también su valoración objetivo de $1.4 trillones. El movimiento refleja ajustes en la estrategia de financiamiento de la compañía en un contexto de presiones en el mercado.

title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
summary:
arXiv:2610.37786v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities.
  We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture.
  We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted WebHarbor, WebAnything achieves higher aggregate scores on three fidelity metrics, with 12 wins, two ties, and no losses in a blind audit. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on 5,856 interaction trajectories improves REAL success by 9.9 percentage points, Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg and Task Avg by 6.25 and 6.32 percentage points, and WebArena-Verified Overall success by 13.33 percentage points under the fixed harness. Code: https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything

title_es: OpenAI fortalece protecciones de seguridad en ChatGPT para menores
bajada: OpenAI publicó un reporte sobre seguridad comunitaria e implementó nuevas salvaguardas en ChatGPT enfocadas en prevención de violencia e intervención temprana. La iniciativa incluye un compromiso con reportes públicos sobre seguridad y protección específica para usuarios adolescentes.
bajada_en: OpenAI published a community safety report and implemented new ChatGPT safeguards focused on violence prevention and early intervention. The initiative includes a commitment to public safety reporting and specific protections for teen users.

title: Community safety report and new protections for teens
summary: OpenAI is strengthening violence prevention in ChatGPT with expanded safeguards, earlier interventions, and a new commitment to public safety reporting.
title_es: OpenAI actualiza Model Spec con cinco valores centrales para IA
bajada: OpenAI publicó una versión actualizada de su Model Spec que define cinco valores fundamentales para guiar IA más capaz hacia mejor juicio, agencia humana y fidelidad a la intención humana. El documento serve como marco para el desarrollo de modelos alineados con objetivos de seguridad y beneficio.
bajada_en: OpenAI released an updated Model Spec defining five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent. The document serves as a framework for developing aligned models that meet safety and benefit objectives.

title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.
title_es: Apple Intelligence llega a China con iOS 27.3 en diciembre
bajada: Apple anunció que lanzará Apple Intelligence en China con iOS 27.3, iniciando con una beta el 4 de noviembre y el lanzamiento completo en diciembre. La expansión marca la entrada de las capacidades de IA de Apple en el mercado regulatorio más restrictivo del mundo.
bajada_en: Apple announced it will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, starting with a beta on November 4 and full release in December. The expansion marks Apple's entry of AI capabilities into the world's most restrictive regulatory market.

title_es: Soft Multi-Token Prediction mejora entrenamiento sin overhead adicional
bajada: Un nuevo paper propone Soft-MTP, una mejora a Multi-Token Prediction que requiere solo un cambio de una línea de código y genera mejoras sin costo computacional adicional. El trabajo es relevante para researchers optimizando pre-training de LLMs.
bajada_en: A new paper proposes Soft-MTP, an improvement to Multi-Token Prediction requiring only a one-line code change with performance gains at no computational cost. The work is relevant for researchers optimizing LLM pre-training.

title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right [R]
summary: Sharing one of our latest papers on Multi-Token Prediction (MTP). MTP is now a standard recipe for frontier pre-training but turns out, it can be done much better.We show the standard MTP gradient hides a KL self-distillation signal (which we want for improving speculative decoding) behind a noisy residual (that harms next-token prediction).I think the coolest part was the KL gradient–recovery trick to extract the KL gradient. You just need a one-line code change:h_ntp += h_mtp.detach() - h_mtpSoft Multi-Token Prediction (Soft-MTP)is essentially a free lunch that improves MTP across a range of tasks.I'm super excited about this work. title_es: WebAnything: framework automatizado para entrenar agentes web
bajada: WebAnything es un framework que reconstruye automáticamente entornos web ejecutables desde URLs reales sin ingeniería manual por sitio. El trabajo facilita el entrenamiento y evaluación reproducible de agentes web a escala en 244 sitios web diferentes.
bajada_en: WebAnything is a framework that automatically reconstructs executable web environments from real URLs without per-site manual engineering. The work enables reproducible training and evaluation of web agents at scale across 244 websites.

title_es: Ollie, asistente de IA enfocado en privacidad, cierra operaciones
bajada: Ollie, un asistente de IA diseñado con privacidad como prioridad, anunció su cierre en una semana. El shutdown refleja la creciente dificultad de competir en un mercado saturado de asistentes de IA con modelos de negocio sostenibles.
bajada_en: Ollie, an AI assistant built with privacy as a priority, announced it will shut down in one week. The closure reflects the growing difficulty of competing in a saturated AI assistant market with sustainable business models.

title: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
summary: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.
title_es: IA agentica acelera búsqueda de señales extraterrestres
bajada: Investigadores están utilizando agentes de IA para analizar datos en la búsqueda de inteligencia extraterrestre, marcando un salto significativo en SETI. El enfoque sugiere que futuras comunicaciones alienígenas podrían detectarse por sistemas de IA en lugar de humanos.
bajada_en: Researchers are using AI agents to analyze data in the search for extraterrestrial intelligence, marking a major leap forward in SETI. The approach suggests future alien communications might be detected by AI systems rather than humans.
